claude_proposed_widenings.name: persistent_area_save family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Zone of Truth plants a persistent non-concentration area that evaluates each creature on first entry in a turn or on turn-start via a save gate. No existing spell family handles this pattern: activation fires a save once at cast; anchored_trigger releases a signal effect (not a save gate); ongoing_effect only carries roll_modifier or damage_on_hit operations.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: a creature that enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Charisma saving throw

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition: compelled_honesty (behavioral speech constraint)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect on a failed save is a behavioral restriction on speech ('can't speak a deliberate lie while in the radius'). This is not any of the 14 standard SRD conditions. The current Condition type in types.ts only includes 'prone'. The constraint needs a new Condition variant or a dedicated effect atom distinct from apply_condition.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, a creature can't speak a deliberate lie while in the radius.
